item.title: USDA offering disaster assistance to Arkansas farmers impacted by winter storms
item.description: The USDA is offering technical and financial assistance to Arkansas farmers and livestock producers impacted by winter storms, including the Livestock Indemnity Program, Noninsured Crop Disaster Assistance Program, and loan guarantees.

item.title: A look at the candidates in the 2026 Arkansas governor primary
item.description: Early voting is underway as Arkansans head to the polls to cast ballots in the March 3 primary election.

item.title: Former England assistant principal enters court plea on rape, grooming charges
item.description: Trent Morgan, the former assistant principal of England High School, has pleaded not guilty to charges of rape and sexual grooming of a child, with a trial scheduled for May.

item.title: Students, parents rally after Star City band director’s contract isn't renewed
item.description: Dozens of students, parents and community members rallied Monday night after the Star City School District chose not to renew the contract of longtime band director Brian York, a decision that has sparked protests and emotional pleas for reconsideration.

item.title: Early voting underway in Arkansas for the March 3 primary & election
item.description: Arkansans can early vote from Feb. 17 through March 2 for the March 3 election, which includes a preferential primary and a special election for House District 70 and Senate District 26.

item.title: Arkansas Storm Team Blog: Wildfire danger is back on Tuesday
item.description: Warmer air, blustery southwest winds, dry air, and the ongoing drought meet to bring another day of elevated wildfire danger to Arkansas on Tuesday, February 24. Practice wildfire safety precautions.
